# ionic-logging-service

> Logging functionalities for apps built with Ionic framework

> Generated by compodoc 2.0.0 at 2026-07-15T13:48:04.273Z, llm-md export.

## Services / Injectables

### LoggingService

File: `src/lib/logging.service.ts`
providedIn: `root`

Description: Service for logging functionality. By default, the following settings are used: logger: root with level WARN appender: BrowserConsoleAppender with threshold DEBUG and MemoryAppender with threshold ALL Via configure , it is possible to amend these settings.

Methods:
- `configure(configuration?: LoggingServiceConfiguration): void` — Configures the logging depending on the given configuration.
- `getLastAjaxAppenderFailure(): Signal<string | undefined>` — Error messages when the ajax appender could not send log messages to the server.
- `getLogger(loggerName: string): Logger` — Gets a logger with the specified name, creating it if a logger with that name does not already exist.
- `getLogMessages(): Signal<LogMessage[]>` — Gets the last log messages. The log messages are retrieved from the internal MemoryAppender . That means you will get only the most current messages. The number of the messages is limited by its maxMessages value.
- `getLogMessagesFromLocalStorage(localStorageKey: string): LogMessage[]` — Loads the log messages written by the LocalStorageAppender with the given key.
- `getRootLogger(): Logger` — Gets the root logger from which all other loggers derive.
- `removeLogMessages(): void` — Remove all log messages.
- `removeLogMessagesFromLocalStorage(localStorageKey: string): void` — Removes the log messages written by the LocalStorageAppender with the given key.

## Classes

### AjaxAppender

File: `src/lib/ajax-appender.model.ts`
Extends: `log4javascript.Appender`

Description: An appender which sends the log messages to a server via HTTP. A typical configuration could be: Example : { "url": "https://my.backend.xy/LoggingBackend", "batchSize": 10, "timerInterval": 60000, "threshold": "INFO" }

Methods:
- `append(loggingEvent: log4javascript.LoggingEvent): void` — Appender-specific method to append a log message.
- `configure(configuration: AjaxAppenderConfiguration): void` — Configures the logging depending on the given configuration. Only the defined properties get overwritten. Neither url nor withCredentials can be modified.
- `getBatchSize(): number` — Returns the number of log messages sent in each request.
- `getInternalAppender(): log4javascript.AjaxAppender` — Get the internally used appender. Mainly for unit testing purposes.
- `getLastFailure(): Signal<string | undefined>` — Last error message when the appender could not send log messages to the server.
- `getLayout(): log4javascript.Layout` — Returns the appender's layout.
- `getTimerInterval(): number` — Returns the length of time in milliseconds between each sending of queued log messages.
- `setBatchSize(batchSize: number): void` — Sets the number of log messages to send in each request.
- `setLayout(layout: log4javascript.Layout): void` — Sets the appender's layout.
- `setTimerInterval(timerInterval: number): void` — Sets the length of time in milliseconds between each sending of queued log messages.
- `toString(): string` — Gets the appender's name. Mainly for unit testing purposes.

### JsonLayout

File: `src/lib/json-layout.model.ts`
Extends: `log4javascript.JsonLayout`

Description: Formats a logging event into JavaScript Object Notation (JSON). The implemenatation is mainly the same as with log4javascript.JsonLayout, with an improvement of serializing messages containing '"'."

Methods:
- `format(loggingEvent: LoggingEvent): string` — Formats the log message.
- `toString(): string` — Gets the layout's name. Mainly for unit testing purposes.

### LocalStorageAppender

File: `src/lib/local-storage-appender.model.ts`
Extends: `log4javascript.Appender`

Description: An appender which stores the log messages in the browser's local storage. The messages are saved JSON-serialized. You have to configure which key is used for storing the messages. A typical configuration could be: Example : { "localStorageKey": "myLogs", "maxMessages": 500, "threshold": "INFO" }

Methods:
- `append(loggingEvent: log4javascript.LoggingEvent): void` — Appender-specific method to append a log message.
- `clearLog(): void` — Removes all messages from local storage. Mainly for unit testing purposes.
- `configure(configuration: LocalStorageAppenderConfiguration): void` — Configures the logging depending on the given configuration. Only the defined properties get overwritten. The localStorageKey cannot be modified.
- `getLocalStorageKey(): string` — Get the key which is used to store the messages in the local storage.
- `getLogMessages(): LogMessage[]` — Gets all messages stored in local storage. Mainly for unit testing purposes.
- `getMaxMessages(): number` — Get the maximum number of messages which will be stored in local storage.
- `loadLogMessages(localStorageKey: string): LogMessage[]` — Load log messages from local storage which are stored there under the given key.
- `removeLogMessages(localStorageKey: string): void` — Remove log messages from local storage which are stored there under the given key.
- `setMaxMessages(value: number): void` — Set the maximum number of messages which will be stored in local storage. If the appender stores currently more messages than the new value allows, the oldest messages get removed.
- `toString(): string` — Gets the appender's name. Mainly for unit testing purposes.

### Logger

File: `src/lib/logger.model.ts`

Description: Logger for writing log messages.

Methods:
- `debug(methodName: string, ...params: any[]): void` — Logs a message at level DEBUG.
- `entry(methodName: string, ...params: any[]): void` — Logs the entry into a method. The method name will be logged at level INFO, the parameters at level DEBUG.
- `error(methodName: string, ...params: any[]): void` — Logs a message at level ERROR.
- `exit(methodName: string, ...params: any[]): void` — Logs the exit of a method. The method name will be logged at level INFO, the parameters at level DEBUG.
- `fatal(methodName: string, ...params: any[]): void` — Logs a message at level FATAL.
- `formatArgument(arg: any): string` — Formats the given argument.
- `getInternalLogger(): log4javascript.Logger` — Returns the internal Logger (for unit tests only).
- `getLogLevel(): LogLevel` — Get the log level.
- `info(methodName: string, ...params: any[]): void` — Logs a message at level INFO.
- `setLogLevel(level: LogLevel): void` — Set the log level.
- `trace(methodName: string, ...params: any[]): void` — Logs a message at level TRACE.
- `warn(methodName: string, ...params: any[]): void` — Logs a message at level WARN.

### LogLevelConverter

File: `src/lib/log-level.converter.ts`

Description: Helper class for converting log levels from and to different data type.

Methods:
- `levelFromLog4Javascript(level: log4javascript.Level): LogLevel` — Converts log4javascript.Level to internal LogLevel.
- `levelFromString(level: string): LogLevel` — Converts string representation to internal LogLevel.
- `levelToLog4Javascript(level: LogLevel): log4javascript.Level` — Converts internal LogLevel to log4javascript.Level.

### MemoryAppender

File: `src/lib/memory-appender.model.ts`
Extends: `log4javascript.Appender`

Description: An appender which stores the log messages in the browser's memory. The MemoryAppender is enabled by default. If you do not specify anything else, it is using this configuration: Example : { "memoryAppender": \[ { "maxMessages": 250, "threshold": "ALL" } }

Methods:
- `append(loggingEvent: log4javascript.LoggingEvent): void` — Appender-specific method to append a log message.
- `configure(configuration: MemoryAppenderConfiguration): void` — Configures the logging depending on the given configuration. Only the defined properties get overwritten.
- `getLogMessages(): Signal<LogMessage[]>` — Gets all messages stored in memory.
- `getMaxMessages(): number` — Get the maximum number of messages which will be stored in memory.
- `removeLogMessages(): void` — Remove all messages stored in memory.
- `setMaxMessages(value: number): void` — Set the maximum number of messages which will be stored in memory. If the appender stores currently more messages than the new value allows, the oldest messages get removed.
- `toString(): string` — Gets the appender's name. Mainly for unit testing purposes.

## Interfaces

### AjaxAppenderConfiguration

File: `src/lib/ajax-appender.configuration.ts`

Description: Configuration for AjaxAppender.

Properties:
- `batchSize?: number` — Number of log messages sent in each request. Default: 1.
- `threshold?: string` — Threshold. Valid values are: ALL, DEBUG, ERROR, FATAL, INFO, OFF, TRACE, WARN Default: WARN.
- `timerInterval?: number` — Interval for sending log messages (in milliseconds). If set to 0, every message will be sent immediatedly. Default: 0.
- `url: string` — Url to send JavaScript logs
- `withCredentials?: boolean` — Specifies whether cookies should be sent with each request. Default: false.

### BrowserConsoleAppenderConfiguration

File: `src/lib/browser-console-appender.configuration.ts`

Description: Configuration for BrowserConsoleAppender.

Properties:
- `threshold?: string` — Threshold. Valid values are: ALL, DEBUG, ERROR, FATAL, INFO, OFF, TRACE, WARN Default: DEBUG.

### LocalStorageAppenderConfiguration

File: `src/lib/local-storage-appender.configuration.ts`

Description: Configuration for LocalStorageAppender.

Properties:
- `localStorageKey: string` — Key which is used to store the messages in the local storage.
- `maxMessages?: number` — Maximum number of log messages stored by the appender. Default: 250.
- `threshold?: string` — Threshold. Valid values are: ALL, DEBUG, ERROR, FATAL, INFO, OFF, TRACE, WARN Default: WARN.

### LoggingServiceConfiguration

File: `src/lib/logging-service.configuration.ts`

Description: Partial configuration definition for LoggingService.

Properties:
- `ajaxAppender?: AjaxAppenderConfiguration` — Settings for AjaxAppender.
- `browserConsoleAppender?: BrowserConsoleAppenderConfiguration` — Settings for BrowserConsoleAppender.
- `localStorageAppender?: LocalStorageAppenderConfiguration` — Settings for LocalStorageAppender.
- `logLevels?: { loggerName: string; logLevel: string }[]` — Log levels for different loggers. Default: root: WARN
- `memoryAppender?: MemoryAppenderConfiguration` — Settings for MemoryAppender.

### LogMessage

File: `src/lib/log-message.model.ts`

Description: Log message.

Properties:
- `level: string` — Log level.
- `logger: string | undefined` — Name of the logger.
- `message: string[]` — Message.
- `methodName: string` — Method, in which the message was written.
- `timeStamp: Date` — Time when the log was written.

### MemoryAppenderConfiguration

File: `src/lib/memory-appender.configuration.ts`

Description: Configuration for MemoryAppender.

Properties:
- `maxMessages?: number` — Maximum number of log messages stored by the appender. Default: 250.
- `threshold?: string` — Threshold. Valid values are: ALL, DEBUG, ERROR, FATAL, INFO, OFF, TRACE, WARN. Default: ALL.

## Public enumerations

- `enum LogLevel` — Logging levels.
  - `ALL`
  - `TRACE`
  - `DEBUG`
  - `INFO`
  - `WARN`
  - `ERROR`
  - `FATAL`
  - `OFF`
